_schema._comment: URL/path normalization profiles, one per parser family. Names and values compare under the profile the collector's product parses with. A profile is per parser FAMILY, not per product and never per CVE: it records how that parser resolves a request path before the application sees it, which is what decides whether two recorded labels denote one resource.

_fields.applies_to: the parser family this profile describes
_fields.case_sensitive: false when the parser folds case before matching
_fields.separators: characters the parser accepts as a path separator
_fields.unicode_escape: decode the non-standard %uXXXX form before comparison
_fields.remove_dot_segments: resolve . and .. against the path, per RFC 3986 section 5.2.4
_fields.trim_trailing: characters trimmed from the end of a segment before comparison

rfc3986.applies_to: generic URI parsing, the default where the product's parser is not distinguished

tomcat.applies_to: Tomcat and the servlet containers that follow it, where a path parameter may follow any segment

aspnet.applies_to: ASP.NET routing above IIS, which resolves an encoded separator before routing

windows-path.applies_to: Windows filesystem paths as a host collector records them, not request paths
